project.name: WoGu Sample: Temporal Project
project.description:
Demonstrates wogu-maven-plugin against real Temporal Java SDK code. PaymentWorkflowImpl calls UUID.randomUUID(), which breaks workflow replay determinism, so 'mvn verify' intentionally fails here and writes target/wogu/index.html showing the violation.
This module is intentionally excluded from the repo's default Maven reactor (see the root pom's 'with-samples' profile), since it fails by design. Run it explicitly: mvn -f sample-temporal-project verify
